Specification: This module models a TLC-like reachability model checker that performs breadth-first exploration over a graph of states, with a parameter K controlling whether exploration is strict BFS (K = 1) or degraded non-strict BFS (K > 1) to approximate multiple workers. The state graph is given as a record with states, initial states, and an action relation, and the model checker tracks explored states, a queue of pending states, predecessor information, and BFS levels in order to detect violations and reconstruct counterexamples. The specification verifies termination of the translated PlusCal algorithm and a liveness-style property stating that when violation states exist, the eventual counterexample belongs to a supplied set of known counterexamples, with an additional minimal-length requirement when K = 1; it also includes a refinement mapping to an instantiated MCReachability specification.
AssumptionNames:
/\ IsGraph(StateGraph)
       /\ ViolationStates \subseteq StateGraph.states
       /\ K \in Nat \ {0}
       /\ \A s \in StateGraph.states : \A l \in Nat : Constraint(s, l) \in BOOLEAN
IfThenElse: IF a < b THEN a ELSE b

IF i \leq Len(S)
              THEN /\ state' = S[i]
                   /\ C' = (C \cup {state'})
                   /\ L' = (state' :> 0) @@ L
                   /\ i' = i + 1
                   /\ IF state' \in ViolationStates
                         THEN /\ counterexample' = <<state'>>
                              /\ pc' = "trc"
                         ELSE /\ pc' = "init"
                              /\ UNCHANGED counterexample
              ELSE /\ pc' = "initPost"
                   /\ UNCHANGED << C, state, i, counterexample, L >>

IF state' \in ViolationStates
                         THEN /\ counterexample' = <<state'>>
                              /\ pc' = "trc"
                         ELSE /\ pc' = "init"
                              /\ UNCHANGED counterexample

IF Len(S) # 0
              THEN /\ \E idx \in 1..Min(K, Len(S)):
                        /\ state' = S[idx]
                        /\ S' = RemoveAt(S, idx)
                   /\ successors' = SuccessorsOf(state', StateGraph) \ C
                   /\ IF SuccessorsOf(state', StateGraph) = {}
                         THEN /\ counterexample' = <<state'>>
                              /\ pc' = "trc"
                         ELSE /\ pc' = "each"
                              /\ UNCHANGED counterexample
              ELSE /\ Assert(S = <<>>, 
                             "Failure of assertion at line 204, column 8.")
                   /\ pc' = "Done"
                   /\ UNCHANGED << S, state, successors, counterexample >>

IF SuccessorsOf(state', StateGraph) = {}
                         THEN /\ counterexample' = <<state'>>
                              /\ pc' = "trc"
                         ELSE /\ pc' = "each"
                              /\ UNCHANGED counterexample

IF successors # {}
              THEN /\ \E succ \in successors:
                        /\ successors' = successors \ {succ}
                        /\ IF Constraint(succ, L[state] + 1)
                              THEN /\ C' = (C \cup {succ})
                                   /\ S' = S \o <<succ>>
                                   /\ T' = T \o << <<state,succ>> >>
                                   /\ L' = (succ :> (L[state] + 1)) @@ L
                              ELSE /\ TRUE
                                   /\ UNCHANGED << S, C, T, L >>
                        /\ IF succ \in ViolationStates
                              THEN /\ counterexample' = <<state, succ>>
                                   /\ pc' = "trc"
                              ELSE /\ pc' = "each"
                                   /\ UNCHANGED counterexample
              ELSE /\ pc' = "scsr"
                   /\ UNCHANGED << S, C, successors, counterexample, T, L >>

IF Constraint(succ, L[state] + 1)
                              THEN /\ C' = (C \cup {succ})
                                   /\ S' = S \o <<succ>>
                                   /\ T' = T \o << <<state,succ>> >>
                                   /\ L' = (succ :> (L[state] + 1)) @@ L
                              ELSE /\ TRUE
                                   /\ UNCHANGED << S, C, T, L >>

IF succ \in ViolationStates
                              THEN /\ counterexample' = <<state, succ>>
                                   /\ pc' = "trc"
                              ELSE /\ pc' = "each"
                                   /\ UNCHANGED counterexample

IF Head(counterexample) \notin StateGraph.initials
             THEN /\ counterexample' = <<Predecessor(T, Head(counterexample))>> \o counterexample
                  /\ pc' = "trc"
             ELSE /\ Assert(counterexample # <<>>, 
                            "Failure of assertion at line 217, column 20.")
                  /\ pc' = "Done"
                  /\ UNCHANGED counterexample

IF K = 1
                    THEN LET lens   == {Len(cx) : cx \in Counterexamples}
                             minLen == CHOOSE m \in lens : \A n \in lens : m <= n
                         IN  Len(counterexample) = minLen
                    ELSE TRUE

IF pc \in {"init", "initPost"}
                       THEN 0
                       ELSE IF pc = "scsr" /\ successors = {} /\ C = SeqToSet(S)
                            THEN 0
                            ELSE L[state] + 1

                            THEN 0
